review_axis: Spec: final integration, state ownership, scope and viewport accessibility
review_target: Current working changes and new runtime files; not a committed revision.

spec.rule: Vorschau destination excluded; preserve existing entry and stable same-frame Joy/Taego selection.
Preserve Journey and FirstRunCoordinator save/completion contracts; no unrelated state changes.

checks.evidence: FirstRunCoordinator and its test are byte-identical to base. IntroGate and Consent code match base after checkout line-ending normalization. Splash and Journey still route required gate state to IntroGateScreen.
Only journey diff is pushAndRemoveUntil in _replace, preventing stale first-run routes underneath gate or AppShell. Coordinator commit sequencing remains unchanged.

Start guards busy/local data lifetime, writes only welcomeSeen then opens ConsentScreen. Later opens existing read-only AppReviewDemoScreen. Neither action grants consent, onboarding completion, progress or reward.

New C presentation delegates level/purpose/companion and Continue/Back callbacks. Level sheet keeps draft until Apply; Close discards draft. No preference/progress/economy writes in new C presentation files.
Existing OnboardingGamesDemo(level: level) destination preserved. Games demo/support content matches main; demo JSON is byte-identical. No new destination screen or game implementation.

Unwraps only app-owned SoriComfortTextScaler and retains exact OS/custom base scaler. Pane and modal opt-in recompute comfort from constrained bounds. Existing global SoriTypeScale.build is unchanged; real accessibility scaling remains active.

Original Spec review made no runtime/test/Git mutations. A subsequent root-authorized TTS blocker repair changed only lib/widgets/sori/tts_unavailable_banner.dart and test/tts_unavailable_banner_test.dart; this review JSON was updated. Root owns integration and browser recheck.

MaterialApp.builder puts the recovery strip above Navigator, without an Overlay ancestor. Guard tooltip creation with Overlay.maybeOf; use the same localized close label as icon semantics when absent. Keep routed tooltips and the original clearUnavailable callback; no layout, service, consent or progress change.

resolved_findings.title: Root TTS close tooltip crashes without an Overlay ancestor
resolved_findings.trigger: TTS unavailable banner displayed through main MaterialApp.builder, then hovered/dismissed before continuing onboarding.
resolved_findings.root_cause: IconButton.tooltip builds RawTooltip outside Navigator Overlay; its ErrorWidget produces a huge Row overflow.

red_evidence.result: No Overlay widget found; Row overflowed by 99274 pixels

resolved_findings.repair: Reuse the narrowly scoped original WIP stash overlay guard, preserving localized accessible close action.
